<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def barpos():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return min(rs),min(cs)
def check(r): return bool(r.get('level_completed') or r.get('run_complete') or r.get('done'))
def path_to(tr,tc):
    r,c=barpos(); seq=[]
    while (r,c)!=(tr,tc):
        if r<tr: seq.append('DOWN'); r+=4
        elif r>tr: seq.append('UP'); r-=4
        elif c<tc: seq.append('RIGHT'); c+=4
        else: seq.append('LEFT'); c-=4
    return seq
# sweep start row 36 across cols
cols=[20,24,28,32,36,40,44,16,12,8,4,0]
print('start',barpos())
for tc in cols:
    seq=path_to(36,tc)
    r=action(seq) if seq else action(['SPACE'])
    if r.get('game_over'): print('GO at col',tc,'now',barpos()); break
    if check(r): print('WIN at (36,%d)'%tc); break
print('final',barpos(),'state',last_action_result.get('state'))
</parameter>
</function>

def barpos():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':

def check(r): return bool(r.get('level_completed') or r.get('run_complete') or r.get('done'))
def path_to(tr,tc):
    r,c=barpos(); seq=[]
    while (r,c)!=(tr,tc):
        if r<tr: seq.append('DOWN'); r+=4
        elif r>tr: seq.append('UP'); r-=4
        elif c<tc: seq.append('RIGHT'); c+=4
        else: seq.append('LEFT'); c-=4
    return seq
